info.title: Heyo Platform API — Demo
info.description: A deliberately broad mock SaaS API with organizations, product data, customer data, billing, files, asynchronous jobs, audit trails, and webhooks. Every example is fictional.

post.description: Exchanges mock credentials for a short-lived member access token and a refresh token.
Rotates a refresh token and returns a fresh access-token pair.

401.description: Refresh token is invalid or expired.

get.description: Returns organizations visible to the current actor.

post.description: Creates an organization and makes the caller its owner.

422.description: Organization name or slug is invalid.

get.description: Returns organization profile, plan, settings, and limits.

patch.description: Updates editable organization properties. Send the current ETag to avoid replacing a newer change.

409.description: ETag does not match the latest organization.

get.description: Lists active, invited, and suspended members.

post.description: Sends an invitation with the requested workspace role and project access.

409.description: Member is already active or invited.

patch.description: Changes a member's role, project access, or account state.

delete.description: Revokes the member's access while retaining their audit history.

409.description: Organization must retain at least one owner.

get.description: Lists projects with optional status, owner, and tag filters.

post.description: Creates a project and its initial development environment.

get.description: Returns project configuration, owner, metrics summary, and environments.

patch.description: Updates project name, owner, tags, status, and notification settings.

409.description: The project changed since it was read.

delete.description: Archives a project. Its data remains readable to administrators for 30 days.

get.description: Lists development, staging, production, and custom environments.

post.description: Creates an isolated environment with configurable variables and deployment protection.

get.description: Lists project documents with draft, published, archived, owner, and label filters.

post.description: Creates a draft document with Markdown content and optional labels.

get.description: Retrieves the latest document content and publication metadata.

patch.description: Updates draft content, title, labels, and review state.

409.description: Document was edited by another actor.

delete.description: Moves a document to the archive; it can be restored for 30 days.

post.description: Creates an immutable published version of a draft document.

409.description: Document has no changes to publish.

get.description: Lists customer contacts with search, lifecycle, tag, and creation-date filters.

post.description: Creates a contact and optionally associates it with tags and external identifiers.

409.description: Email already belongs to an existing contact.

get.description: Returns profile, traits, tags, consent state, and activity summary.

patch.description: Updates supported profile fields, traits, tags, and consent state.

422.description: Trait or consent value is invalid.

delete.description: Schedules a contact for deletion and PII redaction.

get.description: Returns immutable product events for an organization and a selected time window.
Returns headline adoption, API reliability, workflow, and revenue metrics.
Lists automation workflows and their recent run health.

post.description: Creates a draft workflow with typed trigger, condition, and action steps.

get.description: Lists workflow runs with triggering event, state, duration, and failed step details.
Lists endpoints, subscribed events, state, and recent delivery health.

post.description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint for selected events and returns the signing secret once.

422.description: Webhook URL or event names are invalid.

get.description: Returns a webhook's configuration and the latest delivery summary; secrets are redacted.

patch.description: Updates URL, description, events, and state for a subscription.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a subscription and cancels any scheduled retries.

get.description: Lists delivery attempts with event metadata, response status, duration, and retry state.

post.description: Queues a new delivery using the original event and the current subscription URL.

get.description: Lists uploaded files, scan state, size, content type, and metadata.

post.description: Creates an upload session and returns pre-signed part URLs for files up to 25 GB.

413.description: Requested file is larger than the plan limit.

get.description: Returns file metadata and a short-lived download URL when the scan state is ready.

423.description: File is still scanning or quarantined.

delete.description: Schedules permanent deletion and invalidates all active download URLs.

get.description: Returns plan, billing cycle, limits, payment status, and upcoming renewal.

patch.description: Updates seats, budget alerts, cost centre, and renewal preference.

422.description: Seat count is lower than active members.

get.description: Lists historical, open, paid, and void invoices for an organization.
Returns consumption and included allowances for each metered feature in a billing period.
Lists key metadata, scopes, expiration, and last-use time; secrets are never returned.

post.description: Creates a scoped service API key and returns its secret exactly once.

422.description: Scopes or expiry date are invalid.

post.description: Revokes an API key immediately and records an immutable audit event.

get.description: Lists security and configuration events with actor, target, IP, and request metadata.
Lists scheduled and one-off export jobs with delivery, encryption, and file details.

post.description: Creates an asynchronous CSV or JSONL export from a saved dataset and filter snapshot.

422.description: Selected columns or delivery settings are invalid.

get.description: Returns public API component health. This endpoint requires no authentication.

503.description: One or more components are unavailable.

BearerAuth.bearerFormat: API key or member access token

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum records to return. Defaults to 25.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Current resource ETag for optimistic concurrency.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for retry-safe writes, retained for 24 hours.
